scope: Basic navigation and Plato tab visibility

findings.title: Login succeeds and redirects to /jobs
findings.detail: Navigated to /auth, filled email rezu.may@wrkhq.com, clicked 'Continue with email', used dev magic link workaround, page redirected to http://app.lvh.me:5007/jobs as expected.

findings.title: Software Engineer job opens candidate view
findings.detail: Clicking the 'Software Engineer' job title navigated to /jobs/17773/stages/124384/applicants/13501/overview, auto-selecting candidate Alonso Parker.

findings.title: Sidebar nav (column 3) shows all expected items including Plato
findings.detail: The candidate sidebar navigation contains: Overview, Resume, Messages, Files, Private notes, and Plato — all present. The Plato nav item contains an img element (gradient chip icon) followed by 'Plato' text, matching spec. Link href: /jobs/17773/stages/124384/applicants/13501/ai.

findings.title: Plato nav item is marked active when Plato tab is open
findings.detail: After clicking the Plato nav item, the accessibility snapshot shows link 'Plato' [active], confirming the active state is correctly applied.

findings.title: Plato tab loads in column 4 with correct header
findings.detail: Column 4 renders with a header bar containing img (gradient chip icon) + 'Plato' text + a close/action button. URL changed to .../ai as expected.

findings.title: Empty state shown is 'Plato needs a resume', not 'Plato hasn't reviewed this candidate yet'
findings.detail: The QA instructions expected the empty state to read 'Plato hasn't reviewed this candidate yet' with a 'Generate summary' button. The actual rendered state is 'Plato needs a resume' / 'Plato reviews a candidate from their resume. Add one to this candidate to get started.' This is because candidate Alonso Parker has no resume attached. This appears to be a correct upstream gating state (resume required before review), not a bug — but it differs from the expected test path. The 'Generate summary' empty state would require a candidate with a resume but no AI summary. No 'Generate summary' button was visible for this candidate.

findings.title: Console errors: pre-existing third-party and Redux warnings, no Plato-specific errors
findings.detail: 6 console errors observed, all pre-existing/unrelated to Plato: (1-3) history package deprecation warnings from legacy vendor bundle, (4-5) 'Store does not have a valid reducer' from combineReducers in vendor bundle (pre-existing Redux warning), (6) 404 for cdn.heapanalytics.com/js/heap-.js (analytics not configured in dev). 1 warning: @reach/tooltip styles not found (pre-existing). No errors related to AI summary fetching, PlatoTab rendering, or the /ai route.

findings.title: No errors from the Plato tab route or AI summary API calls
findings.detail: No 404/500 errors for any /ai_job_application_summaries or /ai/* API endpoints in the console. The Plato tab rendered without JavaScript errors.

summary: Navigation and Plato tab visibility pass. All 6 sidebar nav items present including Plato with gradient chip icon. Plato tab loads in column 4 with correct header (icon + 'Plato' text). Active state on nav item works. No console errors related to the Plato feature. One informational finding: the empty state shown is the 'no resume' gate ('Plato needs a resume') rather than the 'no summary' gate ('Plato hasn't reviewed this candidate yet' + Generate summary button), because the seeded candidate has no resume. This is expected branching behavior but means the Generate summary button path was not exercised by this candidate.
